title: Visit and conservation stories

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study
location.extent: Published video poster and complete associated clip

slide_intent: Connect an invitation with a wider mission, because a museum’s communications must support both attendance and understanding.
strategic_value: The repeated three-panel format can link a playful time-travel visit message with a conservation message about ocean life.
demonstration: The clip first pairs a reptile eye, animated word rings and Travel back in time / Cycle back home; it then pairs ocean footage and a statistic with CHANGE rings and a report invitation.
practical_value: Compare image, expressive transition and explanation as three complementary jobs in a social sequence.

content_islands.name: Image panel
content_islands.spec: Use the left panel for a creature close-up or ocean footage with text.

content_islands.name: Ring panel
content_islands.spec: Animate contextual circular words in the middle panel.

content_islands.name: Message panel
content_islands.spec: Use the right panel for the visit phrase or report call to action.

reference_purposes.Application: The clip first pairs a reptile eye, animated word rings and Travel back in time / Cycle back home; it then pairs ocean footage and a statistic with CHANGE rings and a report invitation.
